Culture Amp is the world’s leading employee experience platform, revolutionizing how 25 million employees across more than 6,000 companies create a better world of work. Culture Amp empowers companies of all sizes and industries to transform employee engagement, drive performance management, and develop high-performing teams. Powered by people science and the most comprehensive employee dataset in the world, the most innovative companies including Canva, On, Asana, Dolby, McDonalds and Nasdaq depend on Culture Amp every day. Culture Amp is backed by leading venture capital funds and has offices in the US, UK, Germany and Australia. Culture Amp has been recognized as one of the world’s top private cloud companies by Forbes and most innovative companies by Fast Company. For more information visit cultureamp.com . How you can help make a better world of work Culture Amp is looking for an exceptional Enterprise Account Executive to join our Enterprise Sales team. In this role, you ll be at the forefront of Culture Amp s growth in the enterprise segment (1,000+ users), hunting new logos and helping the world s most ambitious organisations build a better world of work for their people. You ll bring a consultative, insight-led approach to complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles. You ll partner closely with People Scientists, Customer Success, SDRs, and Marketing to deliver a differentiated experience for enterprise buyers, connecting their people challenges to measurable business outcomes. If you re deeply curious, commercially sharp, and energised by the challenge of winning in a competitive market, you re what we call a #peoplegeek and this role was built for you. You will Drive new logo acquisition across your enterprise territory, owning the full sales cycle from outbound prospecting through to close. Generate a significant portion of your own pipeline through proactive outbounding, using a combination of tools, tactics, and sales methodologies to break into target accounts. Build and manage a robust, accurately forecasted pipeline in Salesforce, maintaining consistent pipeline hygiene and weekly forecast updates. Run tailored, high-impact product demonstrations and business case presentations for People Leaders and executive stakeholders, clearly articulating Culture Amp s competitive differentiators and ROI. Develop specific points of view on your target accounts and build multi-threaded relationships across HR, Finance, and C-suite to drive consensus and accelerate deal velocity. Collaborate cross-functionally with Customer Success, People Science, SDRs, Marketing, Solutions Engineering and RevOps to deliver a seamless, high-quality experience for prospects. Contribute to the broader Enterprise team s craft, sharing learnings, participating in deal clinics, and helping raise the bar on how we sell. You have 6+ years of proven sales experience in a closing role, with a focus on either new business or expansion (or both) A proven track record of consistently meeting or exceeding quota and experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder deals. Strong outbound and self-sourcing capability, with experience building pipeline from scratch rather than relying on inbound and SDR’s channels alone. Deep enterprise sales craft: robust territory and account planning, executive stakeholder engagement, value/ROI-based selling, and the ability to navigate complex commercial negotiations. Experience selling to executive leaders and the ability to connect business initiatives to measurable outcomes. Proficiency in Salesforce and core GTM tools (e.g. Gong, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Outreach); formal sales methodology training (e.g. MEDDPICC, Challenger, Sandler) is a strong plus. Experience in HR tech
